title: MrBeast Rizz
blurb: The world's biggest YouTuber demonstrating charisma with roughly the intensity of a man giving away a private island. Whether the clip shows genuine smoothness or a catastrophic misfire is precisely the argument that made it a meme — the internet has never reached consensus and has stopped trying. That ambiguity is what keeps it useful: it works as sincere hype and as brutal mockery depending entirely on the footage underneath. Play it during any confident approach, ideally one that involves offering somebody a large sum of money to do something inadvisable.
origin: A viral clip of MrBeast's charisma, endlessly debated online.
